questions.question: In synchronous digital sequential logic, what does the term 'setup time' (t_setup) of a flip-flop specifically define?
options: The minimum duration that the data input must remain stable before the active clock edge arrives
The minimum time that the clock pulse must remain continuously in either the high or low state
The propagation delay between the arrival of the clock edge and the output transition of the register
The minimum duration that the data input must hold its value after the active clock edge has transitioned
The maximum allowable difference in clock arrival times between adjacent flip-flops across the chip

questions.question: In deep sub-micron integrated circuit reliability, what is the primary physical cause of electromigration in on-chip metal interconnects?
options: Capacitive crosstalk between closely routed parallel signal traces switching at high frequencies
The physical displacement of conductor metal atoms caused by momentum transfer from high-density drifting electrons
The dielectric breakdown of thin silicon dioxide under prolonged exposure to high electric fields
The gradual threshold voltage shift in MOSFETs caused by charge trapping at the gate dielectric interface
The generation of electron-hole pairs along silicon diffusion regions induced by alpha particle radiation

questions.question: In a processor's memory management unit (MMU), what is the primary function of the Translation Lookaside Buffer (TLB)?
options: To temporarily buffer modified cache lines before they are written back to main memory
To arbitrate memory access requests among competing threads in a simultaneous multithreading core
To serve as a specialized high-speed cache for recently resolved virtual-to-physical address translations
To hold pre-decoded instructions fetched ahead of the current program counter value
To maintain serialized atomic transaction ordering across high-speed point-to-point processor links

questions.question: In dynamically scheduled out-of-order superscalar processors, what is the primary architectural purpose of the Reorder Buffer (ROB)?
options: To dispatch ready micro-operations from the reservation stations to execution functional units
To eliminate write-after-read (WAR) dependencies through physical register identifier mapping
To dynamically predict branch outcome directions using global and local branch history registers
To commit completed instructions strictly in original program order to maintain precise architectural state and exceptions
To coalesce sequential DRAM accesses into wider burst transactions to optimize memory bus bandwidth

questions.question: When designing an asynchronous FIFO buffer spanning two unsynchronized clock domains, why are the read and write pointer values converted to Gray code before being passed across the clock domains?
options: Gray code drastically simplifies the combinational logic required to perform pointer addition and subtraction
Gray code eliminates the need to use multi-stage flip-flop synchronizers in the receiving clock domain
Gray code prevents write pointer overflows by dynamically compressing pointer values into fewer bits
Gray code reduces power consumption by suppressing clock switching across inactive regions of the FIFO
Gray code changes only one bit per state transition, preventing multi-bit transition skew and corrupted pointer values
